text: 创业板指冲高回落跌0.32%，农业股持续走强。 恒指半日涨0.5%，恒生科技指数涨0.6%，商汤、比亚迪电子涨超6%。 日本两年期国债拍卖尾差创2016年以来最大。 国家发改委：全链条推动集成电路关键核心技术攻关取得决定性突破，促进集成电路产业高质量发展。 国家发改委：发展机器人产业必须因地制宜，防止盲目跟风、一哄而上。 高盛称波斯湾地区石油出口量已恢复至战前水平的三分之二 。
text_en: ChiNext turned lower after a morning spike, down 0.32%, with agricultural stocks staying strong. Hang Seng Index rose 0.5% at midday, Hang Seng Tech Index up 0.6%, with SenseTime and BYD Electronic up over 6%. Japan's 2-year bond auction tail gap was the largest since 2016. NDRC: Promote decisive breakthroughs in core technology of integrated circuits across the full chain to drive high-quality industry development. NDRC: Robotics industry development must be tailored to local conditions, avoiding blind imitation and herd behavior. Goldman Sachs says oil exports from the Gulf region have recovered to two-thirds of pre-war levels.
